استشكلوا (form X)
# اِسْتَشْكَلُوا (istaškalū) /is.taʃ.ka.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اُسْتُشْكِلُوا (ustuškilū) /us.tuʃ.ki.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
# اِسْتَشْكِلُوا (istaškilū) /is.taʃ.ki.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَشْكَلَ (istaškala)
